thread:
alice.sre: Heads up, canary in eu-west1 showing elevated 502 rate for tokenizer-service v3.2-canary, started ~00:01 UTC. I think it's regressing with long-tail latency. Need expedited decision: pin to v3.1 or rollforward to v3.2.1?
ben.release: can you paste the last 5m error trend and trace sample? need impact window to sign off.
carla.ml: looking at traces now — mem spike on step encode, GC spikes then 502s. Might be a regression from the new quant path in v3.2. Canary health 42% (was 98%).
mike.ops: infra looks fine, no host OOMs; it's per-process high RSS then crash loop. sounds like model variant change.
alice.sre: snippet of error log: ```2026-03-20T00:03:04Z ERROR tokenizer encode failed: cuda runtime error: out of memory```
ben.release: ok. two options: pin traffic back to v3.1 (safer) or rollforward to v3.2.1 which has the GC patch (not yet deployed here). Do we have available capacity to quick-roll v3.2.1 to canary?
eva.pm: user-facing impact: degraded for ~20% of EU traffic, some sessions get truncated responses. Product prefers pin if quicker.
carla.ml: v3.2.1 build exists in registry with tag tokenizer-v3.2.1; passed unit + quant smoke but not full canary. I can deploy to canary in ~6 mins if ops ok.
mike.ops: we can push v3.2.1 to canary now, but need release lead signoff for expedited change window.
oncall-do: I'm on duty, +1 to quick rollforward if ML confirms fix. else pin.
ben.release: vote: +1 to rollforward to v3.2.1 for canary only, hold GA. Need release note and rollback plan. Who will cut the rollforward?
carla.ml: I'll do the canary roll. Roll command: `redwoodctl rollout start --service tokenizer --from-tag v3.2.1 --to canary --region eu-west1`
alice.sre: also prepped rollback pin command: `redwoodctl rollout pin --service tokenizer --to-tag v3.1 --region eu-west1`
deploy-bot: [deploy job queued] rollout-job-6789 created for tokenizer v3.2.1 -> canary eu-west1 by carla.ml. CI checks: smoke (pass), perf (queued). ETA ~3m.
ben.release: confirm: this is expedited mid-window change. Approvers: ben.release, oncall-do, alice.sre. please react with :thumbsup: to approve.
carla.ml: :thumbsup:
oncall-do: :thumbsup:
alice.sre: :thumbsup: done — kicking off.
deploy-bot: [status] perf-checks: pass. canary deploy started. rollout at 5% traffic.
mike.ops: watching infra, let me know if we need to scale memory config.
carla.ml: canary metrics trending back toward baseline after 90s. error rate 6% -> 1.5%.
eva.pm: thanks team. outline for postmortem: short note about quant path regression, mitigation pinned and rollforward, owners: carla.ml, alice.sre.
ben.release: copying rollout notes into release doc and setting follow-up tasks. Rolling to GA paused until next maintenance window. Thread closed after verifying stability. :white_check_mark:
